content:
T-Mobile US (TMUS) stock fell 16.7% over the past month, diverging from a 2.0% gain for the S&P 500. News reports tied a sharp drop on October 9 to a SpaceX spectrum deal, and AT&T, Verizon and Comcast each lost more than 12% over the same month. You may still think of a wireless carrier as a stock that holds up in a selloff. So how far has T-Mobile stock fallen in past market selloffs?

T-Mobile Stock’s 54% Drop In 2011, Much Of It In One Day

T-Mobile stock recorded its steepest fall in a market shock since 2007 during the US debt ceiling crisis. From July to October 2011, the shares fell 54%, compared with an 18% decline for the S&P 500 over the same months. Market pressure alone does not fully explain the drop. The shares fell from $20.38 to $12.92 on August 2, 2011, a 37% drop in one day.

The 2008-2009 financial crisis marked the next steepest drop. T-Mobile stock fell 47% during that time, a milder decline than the 53% loss for the S&P 500. Over a longer stretch, from a peak in 2007 to a low in 2010, the stock fell 86%.

Historically, T-Mobile stock has traded through 15 market shocks since 2007 . A typical event has been much milder. The stock fell 18.0% on average across these shocks, compared with 15.8% for the index. On average, the shares have dropped slightly more than the broader market.

How Long Did T-Mobile Stock Take To Recover?

The median recovery time from a low was 3.7 months, though four rebounds took more than a year. T-Mobile ultimately returned to its pre-shock high after 13 of the 14 shocks in which it fell. The stock needed 20.6 months to recover from the 2011 decline, a window that includes the one-day break in price. Following the credit crunch of summer 2007, a full recovery required 111.2 months.

Only one recovery remains unfinished. T-Mobile stock is still 43% below the high it reached before the 2025 tariff shock.

Which Of T-Mobile’s Numbers Are Getting Worse?

Several underlying metrics are weakening. T-Mobile reported a slipping profit margin, slower sales growth in the latest quarter, and elevated debt compared with the broader market. The company retained 20% of its sales as operating profit over the past twelve months, down from 23% a year earlier. Sales grew 7.9% in the latest quarter from a year before, a deceleration from the 10.6% growth in the prior quarter. T-Mobile currently carries debt equal to 72.6% of its market value, against 21% for the S&P 500.

Looking toward the third quarter, whose results are still pending, management forecast fewer net new accounts and slower profit growth. During the July 23, 2026 call, the company projected about 250,000 net new postpaid accounts, down from a net 277,000 in the second quarter. Management also forecast an 8% year-over-year increase in core adjusted EBITDA, a profit measure the company guides to. This marks a step down from the 12% growth reported during that call. Management said the slowdown reflects the timing of last year’s acquisitions.

Management also said changes to older rate plans in the third quarter would temporarily raise the number of accounts that leave. The company noted that smartphones are getting more expensive and that it does not intend to raise its subsidies, so customers will pay more.

When the company reports on October 28, 2026, the key metric to watch will be the net number of postpaid accounts T-Mobile added in the third quarter.

chineseSummary: T-Mobile US (TMUS) 股票在过去一个月下跌了 16.7%，与标准普尔 500 指数上涨 2.0% 的涨幅不同。新闻报道将 10 月 9 日的大幅下跌与 SpaceX 频谱交易联系在一起，AT&T、Verizon 和康卡斯特在同月均下跌超过 12%。您可能仍然认为无线运营商是在抛售中坚挺的股票。那么，T-Mobile 股票在过去的市场抛售中下跌了多少？
chineseContent:
T-Mobile US (TMUS) 股票在过去一个月下跌了 16.7%，与标准普尔 500 指数上涨 2.0% 的涨幅不同。新闻报道将 10 月 9 日的大幅下跌与 SpaceX 频谱交易联系在一起，AT&T、Verizon 和康卡斯特在同月均下跌超过 12%。您可能仍然认为无线运营商是在抛售中坚挺的股票。那么，T-Mobile 股票在过去的市场抛售中下跌了多少呢？

T-Mobile 股价 2011 年下跌 54%，其中大部分是在一天内下跌

T-Mobile 股价在市场冲击中录得自 2007 年美国债务上限危机以来的最大跌幅。从 2011 年 7 月到 10 月，该公司股价下跌了 54%，而标准普尔 500 指数同期下跌了 18%。市场压力本身并不能完全解释下跌的原因。 2011年8月2日，该股股价从20.38美元跌至12.92美元，一天内下跌37%。

2008-2009 年的金融危机标志着下一次最大幅度的下降。 T-Mobile 股价在此期间下跌了 47%，跌幅比标准普尔 500 指数 53% 的跌幅要温和。在较长一段时间内，从 2007 年的峰值到 2010 年的低点，该股下跌了 86%。

从历史上看，自 2007 年以来，T-Mobile 股票已经经历了 15 次市场震荡。典型的事件要温和得多。在这些冲击中，该股平均下跌 18.0%，而该指数平均下跌 15.8%。平均而言，该股的跌幅略高于大盘。

T-Mobile 股票需要多长时间才能恢复？

从低点恢复的中位时间为 3.7 个月，尽管有四次反弹需要一年多的时间。 T-Mobile 在经历了 14 次下跌中的 13 次震荡后，最终回到了震荡前的高点。该股需要 20.6 个月的时间才能从 2011 年的跌势中恢复过来，其中包括单日价格的下跌。 2007 年夏季信贷紧缩之后，全面复苏需要 111.2 个月。

只有一项恢复工作尚未完成。 T-Mobile 股价仍比 2025 年关税冲击之前达到的高点低 43%。

T-Mobile 的哪些数据正在变得更糟？

一些基本指标正在减弱。 T-Mobile 报告称，与大盘相比，利润率下滑，最近一个季度的销售增长放缓，债务增加。过去 12 个月，该公司保留了 20% 的销售额作为营业利润，低于去年同期的 23%。最新季度销售额同比增长 7.9%，较上一季度 10.6% 的增幅有所放缓。 T-Mobile 目前的债务占其市值的 72.6%，而标准普尔 500 指数的这一比例为 21%。

展望第三季度，其业绩仍悬而未决，管理层预计净新账户数量将减少，利润增长将放缓。在 2026 年 7 月 23 日的电话会议中，该公司预计新增后付费账户净额约为 250,000 个，低于第二季度的净额 277,000 个。管理层还预测核心调整后 EBITDA（公司指导利润指标）将同比增长 8%。这标志着该电话会议期间报告的 12% 增长率有所下降。管理层表示，经济放缓反映了去年收购的时机。

管理层还表示，第三季度旧费率计划的变化将暂时增加离开的账户数量。该公司指出，智能手机越来越贵，并且不打算提高补贴，因此客户将支付更多费用。

当该公司于 2026 年 10 月 28 日发布报告时，值得关注的关键指标将是 T-Mobile 第三季度新增的后付费账户净数量。

现在您对 TMUS 有了更多的了解。这就是我们的目的：让您在投资之前了解情况。然而，押注单一股票有其自身的风险。
